title: Workload Token Response
description: Short-lived Baobab workload access token (ADR-0006 token profile, ADR-0007 workload identity). The same shape whichever provider issues it and whichever credential mechanism the workload used (ADR-IAM-0019, ADR-IAM-0020).

access_token.description: Bearer access token (a JWT per the ADR-0006 profile) whose claims are WorkloadTokenClaims. A resource server accepts it only after verifying issuer, audience, actor_type and scope itself.

expires_in.description: Token lifetime in seconds. Workload tokens are short-lived and are re-obtained, never refreshed.

WorkloadTokenClaims.description: Claims a workload access token carries (ADR-0006, ADR-0007). Canonical identity is issuer + subject (ExternalIdentity -> Principal); no claim names the provider or its implementation.

iss.description: Issuer URI of the provider that issued the token; a resource server trusts only configured issuers.

sub.description: Issuer-local subject of the workload. With iss it resolves to the canonical workload Principal.

aud.description: Logical audience(s): the resource server(s) from the workload's allowed_audiences.

azp.description: Authorized party: the issuer-local identifier of the workload's registration at the provider.
